newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian gold, silver end lower on weak global trend.
newsitem.headline: Indian gold, silver end lower on weak global trend.

text.p: Indian gold prices ended lower on Monday on weak global trends and sluggish bids, dealers said.
They said fresh arrivals dragged prices lower near close.
Gold fell 95 rupees per 10 gramme during last week.
"Official arrivals remained low but arrivals through unofficial channels continued," one dealer said.
Gold biscuit (116.50 gramme) prices fell 300 rupees to 56,400 per piece. They were down by 1,000 rupees last week.
Silver fell on sluggish industrial bids and weak global trends. Silver was up by 75 rupees per kg during last week.
"Fresh arrivals of imported silver however remained low today but the market witnessed some arrivals of silver sold by the state-owned Hindustan Zinc Ltd," another dealer said.
